text:
li: Fenix onboarding hitting weird auth + TLS flakiness from iOS SDK 1.2.0. They rotate client certs at deploy and then see bursts of 401s + TLS handshake failures. Started ~09:10 UTC. Anyone seen this pattern?
sam: Can you paste a raw log/snippet? Also which auth mode are they on (mTLS-only or mTLS + token fallback)?
li: They opted into strict mTLS (no fallback) for now. Customer sent this from a device log:
```
2026-03-22T09:10:12.123Z ERROR network: TLS handshake failed: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: zeta-772
{"error":"client_cert_missing"}
```
li: Devices are iOS 16.5, using redwood-ios-sdk 1.2.0. Cert rotation is handled by their provisioning service (roll every 10m).
julia: Two hypotheses: 1) cert chain/CA not uploaded to our tenant truststore before rotation (so new cert isn't trusted), 2) cert provisioning race where device tries new cert before CA distribution completes.
sam: Also check device clock skew — short-lived certs + skew will cause validation fails. Ask customer to `date` on device and their provisioning server.
li: Asked them to dump device time and server time. They report device clock drift of ~4 minutes on some devices.
julia: That explains it. With short cert TTLs and strict mTLS, a 4m skew can flip validation. Quick mitigation options: 1) recommend increasing cert TTL to 30m during onboarding, 2) enable token fallback (ephemeral token) while we stabilize cert rollout, 3) allow a brief trust-window by pre-uploading CA to tenant before rotation.
sam: For immediate triage I suggest we temporarily enable token fallback for tenant fenix for 15m, and ask ops to create a short-lived CA upload for the new cert. That lets them complete deploy without user-facing 401s.
ops-bot: Created support ticket S-68211 and applied temporary auth-fallback policy for tenant fenix (15 minutes). Notifying monitoring.
li: Customer will increase cert TTL and sync clocks; they also agreed to pre-upload the CA for the next rotation.
julia: Long-term: we should add a note in onboarding checklist about clock sync and CA pre-provisioning, and add a defensive SDK behavior: if mTLS handshake fails with cert-verify errors, attempt a single ephemeral-token fallback when tenant policy allows. Open a small RFC?
sam: I'll draft a short KB article: "iOS onboarding: mTLS checklist (clock, CA, TTL, fallback)" and a sample `ntp` check snippet.
li: Thanks all — watching logs. Will post update after the next rotation. :pray:
